c74object.name: evi_dynamics
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_dynamics.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_dynamics.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_dynamics.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_clip.genexpr
evi_tanh.genexpr
evi_biquads_filters.genexpr
About this File:
Dynamics functions for evieve

entry.name: limiterHardSoft ( )
entry.description:
No lookahead crunchy fast limiter, almost the same as 'evi_limiterfast.gendsp'
In 1: type=input: xL, Left audio input
In 2: type=input: xR, Right audio input
In 3: type=input: release, Release time in ms
In 4: type=input: knee, Knee softness 0..1
In 5: type=input: choochoo, 0=clip, 1=soft, 2=softer
In 6: type=input: a0, a0 coefficient from smoothCoeff() biquad calculator
In 7: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient from smoothCoeff() biquad calculator
In 8: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient from smoothCoeff() biquad calculator
In 9: type=input: b1, b1 coefficient from smoothCoeff() biquad calculator
In 10: type=input: b2, b2 coefficient from smoothCoeff() biquad calculator
Return 1: Left, Left limiter output
Return 2: Right, Right limiter output
Return 3: Envelope, AGC dynamics envelope output (linear)

entry.name: companderAverager ( )
entry.description:
Averager for the compander
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: companderCrect, Smoothing factor
In 3: type=input: T, T
Return 1: Average, Averaged output

entry.name: companderCompress ( )
entry.description:
Compression part of the compander
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: smoothing, Smoothing factor
In 3: type=input: T, T
Return 1: Compress, Audio output
Return 2: Envelope, Compression factor envelope

entry.name: companderExpand ( )
entry.description:
Expansion part of the compander
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: smoothing, Smoothing factor
In 3: type=input: T, T
Return 1: Expand, Audio output
Return 2: Envelope, Expansion factor envelope
